requirements.requirement: Maternity and Newborn Child Expense Coverage with minimal waiting period
requirements.rationale: High proportion of young corporate employees (avg age 32) and growing families require financial protection for maternity and infant care.
preferred_policy_features: Pre and post natal expense reimbursement
hard_constraints: Must be supported by official policy evidence

requirements.requirement: Sum Insured Restoration / Automatic Refill Benefit for multi-claim events
requirements.rationale: Protects company employees against exhaustion of sum insured due to major medical treatments or multiple family hospitalizations in a single year.
required_policy_features: 100% Sum Insured restore or reload benefit
preferred_policy_features: Same illness and different illness restore trigger
hard_constraints: Must apply automatically without extra manual application

requirements.requirement: No Room Rent Sub-limits / Single Private Room Flexibility
requirements.rationale: Employees require freedom of hospital room category choice (Single Private Room or higher) without incurring co-payment penalties.
required_policy_features: Single Private Room or Any Room category coverage
preferred_policy_features: No daily capping on ICU or room rent charges
hard_constraints: Avoid policies with restrictive 1% sum insured room rent caps

requirements.requirement: Extended Pre and Post Hospitalization Medical Expense Window
requirements.rationale: Covers diagnostic tests prior to hospital admission and follow-up outpatient consultations/medicines post discharge.
hard_constraints: Expenses must directly relate to the hospital admission claim

requirements.requirement: Wide Cashless Network Hospital Network (10,000+ Hospitals in India)
requirements.rationale: Ensures employees across Mumbai, Bengaluru, and Pune can access cashless hospitalization without out-of-pocket stress.
hard_constraints: Network size supported by official brochure documentation

requirements.requirement: Health Rewards & Active Fitness Incentives Program
requirements.rationale: Encourages preventive corporate health habits, active lifestyle tracking, and wellness check-ups.
preferred_policy_features: Up to 100% premium/health returns reward for active steps

requirements.requirement: Comprehensive Day Care Treatment & Advanced Procedure Coverage
requirements.rationale: Covers modern medical procedures, chemotherapy, dialysis, and surgeries not requiring overnight 24-hour admission.
required_policy_features: All day care medical procedures covered
preferred_policy_features: No restriction on specified list of day care treatments

assumptions.assumption: Corporate Group Policy customization allows negotiation of standard individual waiting periods for maternity.
assumptions.why_needed: Brochures present individual retail terms; corporate group negotiations may customize these.
assumptions.effect_on_analysis: Scoring compares standard brochure terms deterministically while highlighting corporate policy negotiation potential.
